product.ta-alphatronic-p50-1.summary: The P50-1 paired two diskette drives in the Alphatronic office range.
product.ta-alphatronic-p50-1.history: Datamation documented this factory configuration in 1985 alongside the other P50 and P60 variants.
product.ta-alphatronic-p50-1.technical.c: The two drives let users keep separate program and work disks. Datamation specifies two 360 KiB diskette drives.
product.ta-alphatronic-p50-1.technical.v: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p50-1.technical.l: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
